reviewer: Claude coordinator and independent Claude review agents (text, illustrations)
text: Independent review agent read the full text against Ryder's The Potter Militant and the nested The Jackal Who Killed No Elephants; every beat is told in full: fall, scar, famine, royal favour, the princes' jealousy, troop review, confession, cuffing, plea, the king's whole tale, the warning and departure.

The frame (the monkey telling the crocodile) and the verses are dropped or turned into prose and dialogue; every change, including keeping 'by birth I am a potter' as the trade word with no community named, is listed in adaptation.changes.

The potter's drinking comes up only in his own honest confession and is never drawn; the cuffing is plain slaps and punches, and the contentNote says so. Clearly distinct from the folk tale ಧೈರ್ಯದ ಮಡಕೆಗಾರ in title, plot and art.

The lioness sends the jackal away out of pity, to save his life; the narrator draws no 'return to your own kind' moral, and a discussion question asks whether judging someone by birth is fair. Age 8+; no em dashes; animals in the neuter.
illustrations: Storyboard 1024x1536, 398 KB; seams measured exactly on the 512 px grid; painted to every edge, no text or gutters.

After review, the scar that drives the plot was redrawn as one diagonal jagged healed scar, visible in panels 2, 3 and 6, never red and never resembling a forehead mark (head-crop edits for panels 2 and 3); panel 3's line is thinner, accepted.

The jackal is grey-brown and lean with tall ears and a bushy tail, clearly unlike the spotted tawny lion cubs; no blood, blows, drink or injury is drawn; the potter wears a draped cotton upper cloth and the princes traditional slippers; no community markers.
The credit line records one generation and six edits in four rounds, including the crop-and-upscale head edits and feathered compositing on the grid.
limitations: AI-agent editorial review, not human Kannada-teacher or scholar certification.
Age bands are editorial judgements against the README table and have not been tested with children, parents or adult readers.
Source fidelity was checked against saved copies of the Wikisource pages of Ryder's 1925 translation, not against Durgasimha's Kannada text or a Sanskrit recension.
Art was generated with Codex CLI on gpt-5.6-sol and judged on the full sheet and 512px panel crops with the grid measured in pixels; edited panels were re-checked by the same independent agent.
